\makeatletter
% A narrow real-path probe: no production helper is stubbed or patched.
% Group level distinguishes the measurement wrapper from nested content.
\newif\ifHCactive
\newif\ifHCwholeflag
\newif\ifHCfirstflag
\newif\ifHCdirectflag
\newif\ifHCmultitrial
\newcount\HCfresh
\newcount\HCwhole
\newcount\HCfirst
\newcount\HCdirect
\newcount\HCordinary
\newcount\HCwrap
\newcount\HCnested
\newcount\HClevel
\newcount\HCfittrials
\newcount\HCfitcalls
\def\HCerror#1{\PackageError{integration-wrapper-hooks}{#1}{Wrapper and nested hook contracts must be preserved.}}
\protected\def\HChook#1{%
  \ifHCactive
    \def\HCseen{#1}%
    \ifx\HCseen\HCstamp\else\HCerror{Hook tokens expanded before box entry}\fi
    \ifnum\currentgrouplevel=\HClevel
      \global\advance\HCwrap by1
    \else
      \global\advance\HCnested by1
    \fi
  \fi}
% This expandable indirection is changed AFTER suppression was installed.
% An eager edef capture would freeze dormant and fail the armed assertion.
\def\HClate{\HChook{dormant}}
\everyhbox\expandafter{\the\everyhbox\HClate}
\def\HCbegin#1#2{%
  \ifHCactive\HCerror{Unexpected recursive measurement probe}\fi
  \def\HCkind{#1}\def\HCexpected{#2}\def\HCstamp{armed}%
  \global\advance\csname HC#1\endcsname by1
  \HClevel=\currentgrouplevel \advance\HClevel by1
  \global\HCwrap=0 \global\HCnested=0
  \HCactivetrue
  \def\HClate{\HChook{armed}}}
\def\HCend{%
  \HCactivefalse
  \ifnum\HCwrap=\HCexpected\relax\else
    \HCerror{Wrong wrapper count on \HCkind}\fi
  \ifnum\HCnested>0\else\HCerror{Nested hooks suppressed on \HCkind}\fi
  \typeout{HC-TRIAL \HCkind: wrapper=\the\HCwrap;nested=\the\HCnested}%
  \def\HClate{\HChook{dormant}}}
\def\HCrestored#1{%
  \edef\HCafter{\the\everyhbox}%
  \ifx#1\HCafter\else\HCerror{Outer everyhbox was not restored}\fi}
\let\HCorigwhole\dte@check@wholefirst
\def\dte@check@wholefirst{%
  \edef\HCsavewhole{\the\everyhbox}%
  \HCwholeflagtrue
  \HCorigwhole
  \HCwholeflagfalse
  \HCrestored\HCsavewhole}
\let\HCorigfit\dte@dosplit@first@fit
\def\dte@dosplit@first@fit{%
  \edef\HCsavefit{\the\everyhbox}%
  \global\HCfittrials=0
  \global\advance\HCfitcalls by1
  \HCfirstflagtrue
  \HCorigfit
  \HCfirstflagfalse
  \ifnum\HCfittrials>1\global\HCmultitrialtrue\fi
  \HCrestored\HCsavefit
  \typeout{HC-FIRST-LOOP trials=\the\HCfittrials}}
\let\HCorigdirect\dte@measure@direct
\def\dte@measure@direct#1{%
  \edef\HCsavedirect{\the\everyhbox}%
  \HCdirectflagtrue
  \HCorigdirect{#1}%
  \HCdirectflagfalse
  \HCrestored\HCsavedirect}
\let\HCorigsingle\dte@box@single
\def\dte@box@single#1#2{%
  \ifHCwholeflag
    \HCbegin{whole}{0}%
  \else
    \ifHCfirstflag
      \global\advance\HCfittrials by1
      \HCbegin{first}{0}%
    \else
      \HCbegin{fresh}{1}%
    \fi
  \fi
  \HCorigsingle#1#2%
  \HCend}
\let\HCorigpiece\dte@measurepiece
\def\dte@measurepiece#1{%
  \ifnum\dte@pagecount=0
    \global\advance\HCfittrials by1
    \HCbegin{first}{0}%
  \else
    \ifHCdirectflag
      \HCbegin{direct}{0}%
    \else
      \HCbegin{ordinary}{1}%
    \fi
  \fi
  \HCorigpiece{#1}%
  \HCend}
\def\HCpositive#1{\ifnum#1>0\else\HCerror{Missing required call-site coverage}\fi}
\AtEndDocument{%
  \HCpositive\HCfresh \HCpositive\HCwhole \HCpositive\HCfirst
  \HCpositive\HCdirect \HCpositive\HCordinary
  \ifHCmultitrial\else\HCerror{No first loop tried multiple pictures}\fi
  \ifnum\HCfitcalls=1\else\HCerror{Unexpected first-fit restart or extra first fit}\fi
  \typeout{HC-COVERAGE fresh=\the\HCfresh;whole=\the\HCwhole;first=\the\HCfirst;direct=\the\HCdirect;ordinary=\the\HCordinary}%
  \typeout{HC-ALL-CHECKS-PASSED}}
\makeatother
